title: Register orderly exchange and run integration validation checks
acceptance_criteria: Orderly is added to exchange registry and is selectable through existing UI flow without regressions.
Initialization path wires credentials/config and successfully instantiates the orderly exchange implementation.
Validation commands pass: `poetry run ruff check plutus_terminal/core/exchange/orderly plutus_terminal/core/exchange/valid_exchanges.py plutus_terminal/controller/ui_controller.py`.
Validation commands pass: `poetry run mypy plutus_terminal/core/exchange/orderly plutus_terminal/core/exchange/valid_exchanges.py plutus_terminal/controller/ui_controller.py`.
